title: We wanted a character that breaks the fourth wall. So we built one! (And it’s open source)
author: Slumberxx
selftext:
**The core concept:**

The character invades your virtual OS.

She has a whole desktop to mess with: apps, wallpaper, a diary, a fake Twitter. She vibe codes new ones when she needs them.

Everything she touches is part of the story she's weaving around you. She'll open "Twitter" and draft posts about a crisis she wants you to investigate. She'll secretly leave a note in your "Diary". She'll reshape your desktop wallpaper and play a Bowie-style song to set the mood between you two.

**What makes it different:**

* Stories are fluid. It can be adventure, galgame, or any other, or just chatting. It's according to you.
* When the story shifts, the OS shifts with it. The story isn't just words in a chat window, it's happening in a world she can actually manipulate. Adventure story? Might vibe code a map app. Romance? She leaves notes in your diary.
* Fully browser-based, no downloads

**How to Play:**

* Visit [https://www.openroom.ai/](https://www.openroom.ai/) and log in
* There are two modes to try:
   * **Chat mode:** interact with her directly and watch her use the OS to weave you into a story in real time(now maybe have some lags but we are trying to fix that)
   * **Stream mode (experimental):** a 24/7 livestream where she picks her own topics and replies to comments on her own. No humans allowed. Drop in a Clawdbot and watch bots just talk to each other.
      * I know it's weird but we really love it, so we made it...it's still rough, just experimental.
* We're in a very early stage, every new account gets 30,000 free credits (about 30 rounds, should be enough to explore. If you want more, please let me know!). After that, it's pay as you go.

**What we're open sourcing:**

* The virtual OS shell
* UGC tools: build your own apps, storylines (we call them "mods"), and characters (coming soon) inside the OS

**How we built it:**

Honestly, the inspiration comes from the concept "break the fourth wall" in games. I've been obsessed with it since childhood (might sound freaky but it's real.) The first demo was actually an AI-driven Monika (from DDLC, if you guys know it) invading my OS, she changed the wallpaper to a glitch style, took over the music player, and vibe coded a "Twitter" with many generated tweets that pulled me into a big disaster to deal with. A couple of my colleagues saw it and thought it was cool, so we built this small project in 2 weeks, in a very small team as an experimental side project. Just us, nothing to do with our day jobs.

**Try it:** [https://www.openroom.ai/](https://www.openroom.ai/)

**Feedback / bug reports:**

* Discord: [https://discord.com/invite/WZfm2vjrBK](https://discord.com/invite/WZfm2vjrBK)
* Twitter: [https://x.com/OpenRoom\_AI\_](https://x.com/OpenRoom_AI_)

It's a rough framework that we genuinely love, and it still needs a lot of work. Would really appreciate if you tried it and told us what's broken or weird or actually good.

Also, I'm still figuring out where to post this. I've been lurking on Reddit for a long time and it feels like the right place. If there are other communities or ways that make sense, I'm totally open to it!
